[[File:Connally.png|thumb|250px|Connally]] '''Connally''' (Japanese: '''クロダ''' ''Kuroda'') is a {{tc|Black Belt}} who trains in [[Veilstone Gym|Maylene's Gym]]. He appeared from ''[[DP066|Lost Leader Strategy!]]'' to ''[[DP068|A Triple Fighting Chance!]]''. In his first appearance, his fellow Black Belts had lost faith in [[Maylene]] because of her loss to [[Paul]], resulting in her developing uncertainty about being a [[Gym Leader]]. However, Connally still believed in her. Connally [[Battle judge|refereed]] Maylene and {{an|Dawn}}'s unofficial [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}, and later, Maylene and {{Ash}}'s Gym battle. During the matches, his knowledge and respect of the Gym's rules helped to bolster Maylene's confidence as a Gym Leader. He was touched, to the point of crying, after Maylene regained her self-confidence as a Gym Leader. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{fighting color}}|bordercolor={{fighting color light}} |ja=石塚運昇 ''[[Unshō Ishizuka]]'' |en=[[Mike Pollock|Herb Lawrence]] |fi=Aku Laitinen |fr_eu=Jean-Marc Delhausse |no=Simen Sand |pl=Mieczysław Morański |es_eu=Eduardo del Hoyo |pt_br=Ricardo Sawaya}}
